name: Knees Up Seated Together
bodyPosition: Seated on the floor. Buttocks on the ground, torso facing the camera with a slight forward lean of the upper body.

legs.bothLegs: Knees bent and pulled upward toward the torso, kept together (knees touching or nearly touching). Thighs close to each other. Feet planted on the floor.
legs.leftLeg: Knee raised and held close to the other knee.
legs.rightLeg: Knee raised and held close to the other knee.

feet: Planted on the floor. Toes pointing slightly outward.
torso: Upright with a subtle forward lean. Shoulders squared and relaxed, facing the camera.

arms.bothArms: Extended downward along the sides of the body. Hands placed on the floor beside or slightly behind the hips for support.

hands: Relaxed, fingers lightly curled, palms down on the floor providing balance.
head: Facing the camera directly, chin level to slightly lowered.
expression: Neutral to slightly intense. Lips closed, serious and composed look with a hint of seduction.
gaze: Strong, direct eye contact with the camera.
